attempts.summary: Configured node1 (RHEL 7.9, BIOS boot, grub2) to boot with audit=1 persistently: updated GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX in /etc/default/grub, applied audit=1 to all grubby kernel entries (default + rescue), and regenerated /boot/grub2/grub.cfg. Rebooted node1 to verify persistence: boot_id changed from 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799 to 69dbbb3c-802f-4342-b277-95dc0bf38d70, confirming an actual restart. Post-reboot /proc/cmdline contains audit=1, auditctl -s reports enabled 1, and dmesg shows "audit: enabled (after initialization)".
